\chapter{Bus, Vehicle, and Cart: No New Signs}
\label{ch:mw-transport-three}
\hlchaptermodality{21}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can recognise, say, read, and write bus, vehicle, and cart using only signs already secured in earlier chapters.}

Three source-attested transport words begin by ear, reuse the established script inventory, and finish in four separately scored skills without claiming a ticket or timetable exchange.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[bas]{Hear \emph{bas} — bus}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-hear-bas}



\begin{quote}
Recall the seven-word shopping payoff, then say expensive and price.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{bas} — \textbf{bus}
\end{quote}

Hear it twice, point to a bus picture, and say it once. Keep the spelling covered until the sound and meaning are easy.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[bas]{\mw{बस} — bus on the page}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-bas}



\begin{quote}
Say bus and maternal grandfather, then write expensive and price.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mw{ब}} + \textbf{\mw{स}} $\to$ \textbf{\mw{बस}} — \emph{bas} — bus
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Look, cover, wait five seconds, and write \textbf{\mw{बस}}.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[gāṛī]{Hear \emph{gāṛī} — vehicle}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-hear-gaadi}



\begin{quote}
Say bus and clothes, write bus and maternal grandfather, then write \textbf{\mw{ड़}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{gāṛī} — \textbf{vehicle}
\end{quote}

Use vehicle as the broad meaning here. Hear the curled middle sound, then say the word once from a vehicle picture.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[gāṛī]{\mw{गाड़ी} — vehicle on the page}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-gaadi}



\begin{quote}
Say vehicle and maternal grandmother, write clothes, then recall the three-word shopping payoff.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mw{गा}} + \textbf{\mw{ड़ी}} $\to$ \textbf{\mw{गाड़ी}} — \emph{gāṛī} — vehicle
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Look, cover, wait five seconds, and write \textbf{\mw{गाड़ी}}. Keep the dot below \textbf{\mw{ड}} and the long-ī mark after it.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[ṭhelā]{Hear \emph{ṭhelā} — cart}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-hear-thela}



\begin{quote}
Say vehicle and bus, then write \textbf{\mw{ठ}} and maternal grandmother.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\emph{ṭhelā} — \textbf{cart; handcart}
\end{quote}

Hear the strong first sound, point to a handcart, and say the word once.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[ṭhelā]{\mw{ठेला} — cart on the page}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-thela}



\begin{quote}
Say cart, husband, and cheap, then write vehicle.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{What to know first}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\mw{ठे}} + \textbf{\mw{ला}} $\to$ \textbf{\mw{ठेला}} — \emph{ṭhelā} — cart
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Look, cover, wait five seconds, and write \textbf{\mw{ठेला}}.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.

\section[Practice]{Retrieve three transport words}

\label{lesson:MW-R16-transport-three}



\begin{quote}
Recall the seven-word shopping payoff, then write \textbf{\mw{त}}, cheap, and \textbf{\mw{ड़}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Hear the three words in a mixed order, give each meaning, read three shuffled cards, then write all three from sound.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[Practice]{Payoff — three transport words in four skills}

\label{lesson:MW-C16-transport-three}



\begin{quote}
Write husband, then say goods.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
1. Identify three heard words. 2. Produce three words from meaning cues. 3. Match three printed cards to meanings. 4. Write all three heard words without a model.

Pass each skill separately. Timetables, tickets, and location phrases remain later work.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://www.marwaripathshala.com/marwari-lesson-10-english}{Marwari Pathshala, Lesson 10}.
\end{tcolorbox}
